queries: SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_remaining, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status;

SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_remaining, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status;
SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_remaining, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status;

SELECT e.status, AVG(CASE WHEN b.spent > 6.0 THEN b.amount - b.spent END) AS average_remaining, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.spent > 6.0 THEN b.budget_id END) AS budget_line_count FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses with no qualifying budget lines are omitted. AVG ignores missing amounts and returns NULL when no difference can be calculated.

alternatives.interpretation: Show every status present in event, including statuses with no qualifying budget lines; their average is NULL and count is zero.
